Post 1
📈 New 100-day low set — then a 155.80-point reversal. ASX 200 closed at 8,726.40, up 1.82%. That kind of whipsaw doesn't happen without conviction. Buyers stepped in hard and didn't let go. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🟢 IT led the charge at +2.97%, Consumer Discretionary +2.42%, Healthcare +2.39%. Energy was the lone holdout, slipping 0.18%. Risk-on rotation, broad and decisive. #ASX #ausbiz #consumerDiscretionary

Post 3
RWC surged 11.92% to AUD 5.07 and LOV jumped 10.58% to AUD 26.54. Two consumer-linked names doing the heavy lifting — the market rewarded anything with earnings leverage today. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,462.31/oz. Silver AUD 63.42/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.6632, metals priced in local terms stay elevated — a quiet tailwind for materials even as the sector lagged the broader rally at +1.72%. #gold #silver #mining #ASX

Post 5
ASX flat year-to-date despite today's 1.82% bounce. The index needs to hold above 8,726 to confirm the reversal is real. What's your read — genuine floor or dead-cat bounce? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
